Software Engineer
positions.description:
I serve as a software generalist at a young company aiming to make self pilot electric aircraft an every day occurrence.

While I sometimes work on the the embedded portions of the software, most of my time is spent building test frameworks for both software and hardware in the loop testing.

positions.title: Senior Aerospace Engineer, CoFounder
positions.description:
Designed, tested, and brought to market a fully autonomous solution (hardware and software) for a vertical takeoff and landing unmanned aircraft. 

Starting with the ArduPilot open source project, I added features and increased reliability of controls, core autonomy, and ground station interface. I identified the need for and architected a modular payload solution, allowing a single aircraft to serve multiple roles across industries.

Worked with manufacturing to identify pain points that could be improved with better software. Created a data-driven quality assurance process to increase out-of-the-box reliability.

Ardupilot, PX4, C++, Matlab, Linear Systems, MAVLink, I2C, UART, RTK, Customer Support, Logfile Analysis, Quality Assurance

positions.title: Aerospace Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for small unmanned aircraft. Remote pilot and instructor pilot for fixed wing and rotary aircraft under 50 pounds.

positions.title: Flight Test Engineer
positions.description:
Performance and flying qualities flight test engineer for the F-35A.

Planned and executed tests to prove system met design specification. Monitored data real time through complex flight test maneuvers.

positions.title: Flight Test Intern
positions.description: Developed a Matlab based GUI to help post-process flight test data.
